diagnostics.publicMessage: The Plugin manifest is not valid JSON.
diagnostics.developerDetail: Parse the manifest as UTF-8 JSON before validation.
diagnostics.remediation: Fix the JSON syntax and run the validator again.

diagnostics.publicMessage: The Plugin manifest schema version is unsupported.
diagnostics.developerDetail: The schemaVersion must equal the contract's manifestSchemaVersion.
diagnostics.remediation: Author the manifest against the generated manifest reference.

diagnostics.publicMessage: The Plugin manifest does not match the required contract.
diagnostics.developerDetail: A required field, field value, or exact object shape is invalid.

diagnostics.publicMessage: A Plugin capability contract version is unsupported.
diagnostics.developerDetail: Each family has an independent supported contractVersion.
diagnostics.remediation: Use the family version listed in the generated manifest reference.

diagnostics.publicMessage: The Plugin package is incompatible with this MDV version.
diagnostics.developerDetail: The host version is outside compatibility.mdv minVersion and maxVersionExclusive, or pluginApiVersion is unsupported.
diagnostics.remediation: Update the compatibility range only after verifying the package against that host.

diagnostics.publicMessage: A Plugin resource path is outside its package boundary.
diagnostics.developerDetail: Resource paths must be normalized bundle-relative POSIX paths without parent segments or backslashes.
diagnostics.remediation: Move the resource under the package root and use its contained relative path.

diagnostics.publicMessage: A declared Plugin resource is missing.
diagnostics.developerDetail: The validator could not read a manifest-declared contained resource.
diagnostics.remediation: Add the declared file or remove the stale resource declaration.

diagnostics.publicMessage: A declared Plugin resource digest does not match its content.
diagnostics.developerDetail: The SHA-256 digest in the manifest differs from the packaged resource bytes.
diagnostics.remediation: Review the resource and update the digest from the intended bytes.

diagnostics.publicMessage: More than one Plugin package declares the same ID.
diagnostics.developerDetail: Package identity collisions fail closed; origin precedence and last-wins are not used.

diagnostics.publicMessage: More than one Plugin capability declares the same ID.
diagnostics.developerDetail: Capability identity collisions fail every affected package closed.

diagnostics.publicMessage: More than one Skill contribution declares the same ID.
diagnostics.developerDetail: Skill contribution identity collisions fail every affected package closed.
diagnostics.remediation: Assign globally distinct Skill contribution IDs.

diagnostics.publicMessage: A Plugin declaration references an unknown resource.
diagnostics.developerDetail: Capability and Skill resource IDs must resolve within the same manifest.
diagnostics.remediation: Declare the referenced resource or remove the invalid reference.

diagnostics.publicMessage: The Plugin package could not be read.
diagnostics.developerDetail: The explicitly registered manifest or package source was unavailable or unreadable.
diagnostics.remediation: Restore the bundled package input and rebuild the application.
